package.description: Desktop pet cat with a todo list and mail notifier

en-US.description: Desktop pet cat with a todo list and mail notifier
en-US.longDescription:
BongoCat Todo is a fork of BongoCat (Tauri 2 + Vue 3 desktop pet) that adds a
hand-drawn style todo list module and a mail notification center. Right-click
the cat to manage your todos; bind your mailbox to get bubble notifications
for new emails — all without leaving your desktop pet.
en-US.name: BongoCat Todo
en-US.releaseNotes:
🚀 Features
- mail:
  - 邮件两窗口支持拖拽调整大小（MailPanel 9-slice + 贴边把手 + 持久化）  -  by @ChHsiching (96ee7)
  - Bubble auto-dismiss setting (T7) — 5s dismiss + hover pause, default off  -  by @ChHsiching (82ecf)
- todo:
  - 待办面板支持拖拽调整大小并持久化用户尺寸  -  by @ChHsiching (64b39)
  - Resize 把手贴纸片可见边框（修'把手在虚空位置'）  -  by @ChHsiching (be380)
  - 迷你输入窗横向可调（零重绘方案）+ 内容百分比锚定  -  by @ChHsiching (0383d)
- winget:
  - Add winget manifest + README install commands  -  by @ChHsiching (8e128)

   🐞 Bug Fixes
- ci:
  - Generate .SRCINFO for AUR push (required by AUR hook)  -  by @ChHsiching (c1316)
  - Expand $pkgname/$pkgver/$url in .SRCINFO output  -  by @ChHsiching (3ecaf)
  - Cd back to workspace before each AUR package iteration  -  by @ChHsiching (e98ed)
  - Pkgbase must equal pkgname for single packages  -  by @ChHsiching (2d2b5)
  - Release workflow needs pnpm before setup-node  -  by @ChHsiching (24f39)
  - Disable pnpm cache in create-release job (no install step)  -  by @ChHsiching (a2277)
  - Remove packageManager field; restore release.yml to v1.3.1  -  by @ChHsiching (6b1f3)
  - MacOS x64 build uses macos-13 (Intel-native) instead of macos-latest  -  by @ChHsiching (68bf5)
  - Revert macOS x64 back to macos-latest  -  by @ChHsiching (ac686)
- mail:
  - 左右边片下端与下移后的底角片联动（角上方 ~11px 透明洞）  -  by @ChHsiching (9f2e3)
  - Mail 页面补 mailSettings $tauri.start（面板尺寸持久化落盘）  -  by @ChHsiching (66e62)
- todo:
  - 错位纸影 SVG 回退固有尺寸 300×150 导致左上裸露大块半透明矩形  -  by @ChHsiching (b87ae)
  - 纸影改 frame 轮廓 drop-shadow + 切片归位，修 filter 逗号分隔无效  -  by @ChHsiching (a65a3)
  - 补齐横边片与右角片 2px 重叠（右上/右下角透明竖缝）  -  by @ChHsiching (75714)
  - 迷你窗恢复原版 SVG 全套视觉（撤 drop-shadow 与 vector-effect）  -  by @ChHsiching (8da29)
  - Mini 把手改带状——消灭边线到窗口边缘的虚空死区  -  by @ChHsiching (326b0)

    View changes on GitHub

zh-CN.description: 带待办模块和邮件通知中心的桌宠应用
zh-CN.longDescription:
BongoCat Todo 是 BongoCat（Tauri 2 + Vue 3 桌宠）的 fork，新增手绘风格待办模块和邮件通知中心。
右键桌宠呼出待办面板，绑定邮箱后新邮件桌宠头顶弹出气泡提醒。
zh-CN.name: BongoCat Todo
